R/ P M TR P V COS II P P

A silver denarius of Severus Alexander (AD 222-235). RIC contains no listing for this coin, which has the reverse legend 'P M TR P V COS II P P' (indicating a date of AD 226) and the image of Pax running left; such coins are, however, listed under the entries for the following two years (nos. 67 and 80).
